name: Montenegro
spiritual_teacher: Monasteries / Retreats (Ostrog Monastery, ancient cloisters of Bay of Kotor, regular retreat camps)
work_strategy: Remote (Digital Nomad Visa: official 0% local tax exemption on foreign income, or d.o.o.)
it_market: Weak (Almost no local market; purely a hub for remote specialists and crypto entrepreneurs)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days 0 €; thereafter GPPFL: 0% ≤700 €, 9% (700–1,000 €) + 13% prirez = 0–31 €/mo (risk of mandatory preduzetnik +130–170 €).
climate: Warm (Mediterranean subtropical climate, 240+ sunny days, long swimming season)
nature: Top Adriatic + Mountains (Crystal-clear Adriatic Sea, Bay of Kotor fjord, Durmitor mountains, Tara River canyon)
english_level: Moderate (High English proficiency in resort towns Budva/Tivat/Kotor; Montenegrin is Slavic and intelligible)
housing_rent: Moderate (~300–400 € Bar/Podgorica on long-term lease outside summer peak)

numbeo_mandatory_fields: Estimated monthly costs for a single person without rent (food, transport, basic household)
Basic utilities (Electricity, Heating, Cooling, Water, Garbage) + Internet (Broadband)

citizenship: 10 years (Practically unattainable for foreigners without special investments)
mortgage_expats: Difficult (Local banks do not lend to temporary residents without permanent residency)
rent_to_buy: Rare (Only personal agreements with foreign developers or villa owners)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Any document confirming Ukrainian citizenship (internal passport, ID, birth certificate). Without status — 90 days visa-free with mandatory tourist tax (1 €/day).
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary protection (1-year protection certificate, renewable). Issued by Ministry of Interior (MUP) alongside tax ID (Matični broj).
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **Despite being non-EU, on 15.10.2026 Montenegro aligned TP rules with EU 2026/1912: first-time military-age male applicants must prove prior residence in UA AND fulfilled military service or legal exemption (simple deferral / відстрочка may be rejected depending on MUP).**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: Child allowance up to age 18 (30–60 €/mo), disability benefit (65.35 €/mo). One-off municipal aid for low-income residents.
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: State hotels with meals in Bar, Sutomore, and Nikšić for those without funds or cars worth >10,000 €. Volunteer support via Pristanište. Off-season rent very cheap (150–250 €/mo).
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: Full free healthcare in state hospitals with health booklet (zdravstvena knjižica). Childbirth and prenatal care are free.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: TP status automatically grants full right to work. Favorable terms for freelancers, IT (0% Nomad Visa), and small business.

items: [Realitica.com](https://www.realitica.com/rentals/Montenegro/) — main Balkan real estate database, direct owner contacts.
[Estitor.com](https://estitor.com/me) — most modern and convenient rental search in Montenegro (Bar, Budva, Podgorica).
[Indomio.me](https://www.indomio.me/for-rent) — large portal with map and detailed filters.

notes: **Strict conditions:** net income `600 / 750 / 800 / 1 000 €/mo` after UA FOP Group 3; no *preduzetnik* / `d.o.o.` registration; >1-year horizon with military deferral.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.legality_over_183d_with_deferral: Montenegro aligned TP rules (until **04.03.2027**) with **EU 2026/1912**: new male applicants must prove actual residence in UA before arrival + exemption/deferral document (Reserve+ with QR). High chance of TP approval, depending on MUP interpretation. **Without TP:** Digital Nomad visa requires **1,800–2,400 €/mo** (3× min wage — unsuitable), visa-free is 90/180 only.
dtt_and_rates: Ukrainian 5% Unified Tax is not credited. Progressive individual PIT without *preduzetnik*: **0%** up to `700 €/mo` (`8 400 €/yr`), **9%** on `700–1 000 €` slice + municipal *prirez* **13%** (most cities) or **15%** (Podgorica/Cetinje) on tax amount. **PIO / FZO = 0 €** without *preduzetnik* registration (basic public healthcare applies under TP). *Year 2+ risk:* if tax office requires *preduzetnik* registration, ~130–170 €/mo social contributions apply.
items: **Tax (13% *prirez*) and budget (Nikšić — cheapest: rent 350–500 €, assuming 330–350 €, winter 110 €, food 170 €, other 40 € → ~670 €/mo; in Bar 1-br starts at 450–700 € → living 770+ €):**
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.verdict: Tax-ideal, but expensive housing eats up `600–750 €` income. Makes sense for >1 year **only at 900–1,000 €/mo income**, subject to TP approval (with renewal risk after 03.2027) and rent ≤350 € in Nikšić.
